money plant.watering: Water when top 2–3 cm soil is dry. Avoid overwatering.
money plant.fertilizer: Use liquid NPK fertilizer every 20–25 days.
money plant.tips: Wipe leaves regularly and avoid harsh direct sunlight.

tulsi.watering: Water lightly every 1–2 days. Do not let soil fully dry.
tulsi.sunlight: At least 4–5 hours of direct sunlight.
tulsi.tips: Pinch flowers regularly to promote leaf growth.

aloe vera.watering: Water once in 2–3 weeks. Soil must fully dry.
aloe vera.fertilizer: Apply succulent fertilizer once every 30 days.
aloe vera.tips: Ensure well-draining soil to avoid root rot.

rose.sunlight: At least 6 hours of direct sunlight.
rose.tips: Remove dead flowers regularly to promote growth.

tomato.watering: Keep soil evenly moist. Water daily in summer.
tomato.tips: Provide support sticks for growth and prune lower leaves.
